item.title: Neil Sedaka, the singer-songwriter behind dozens of hits, dies at age 86
item.description: Neil Sedaka, the hit-making singer-songwriter whose boyish soprano and bright melodies made him a top act in the early years of rock ‘n' roll and led to a second run of success in the 1970s, has died.

item.title: Bakersfield receives additional funding as focus shifts to targeted violence intervention
item.description: Bakersfield officials say violence prevention efforts cannot slow down as the city receives new funding aimed at reducing shootings and homicides.

item.title: State Wrestling Championships brings big crowds and business to Downtown Bakersfield
item.description: Bakersfield Downtown streets are busier as the California State Wrestling Championships brings visitors. local businesses are welcoming the boost, customers are overwhelmed.
